name: Evershine
summary: At Steelgrill's Depot near Kharanos, Pilot Bellowfiz needs a potent brew from Brewnall Village. Rejold Barleybrew's Evershine can warm a traveler or fuel Bellowfiz's siege engine.

sections.title: A Potent Concoction
sections.body: Rejold Barleybrew brews Evershine in Brewnall Village, where his experiments push past ordinary dwarven brewing. The drink is strong enough to knock all but the hardiest dwarves flat. In Dun Morogh's bitter cold, its heat makes it prized despite its force.

sections.title: Fuel for Pilot Bellowfiz
sections.body: Pilot Bellowfiz works from Steelgrill's Depot outside Kharanos, where Evershine serves two purposes. A nip helps him endure the freezing winds, and the volatile alcohol can fuel his siege engine, Jetsteam. Poured into its furnace, the brew gives the engine an explosive surge of emergency power when Bellowfiz is in a tight spot.

aliases: what kind of drink is evershine
faq.answer: Evershine is an exceptionally strong experimental brew made by the dwarven brewer Rejold Barleybrew in Brewnall Village. Its fiery kick can fell even hardy dwarven drinkers.

faq.q: Why does Pilot Bellowfiz want Evershine?
faq.answer: Pilot Bellowfiz drinks Evershine to warm himself against Dun Morogh's chill and uses it as emergency fuel. In Jetsteam's furnace, the volatile spirit gives the siege engine an immediate burst of power.
Brewnall Village lies in western Dun Morogh, along the road west of Kharanos. Local brewers such as Rejold Barleybrew live there, near the snowy hills.
Rejold Barleybrew is an experimental dwarven brewer in Brewnall Village. He makes many drinks, from pleasant ales to fierce brews potent enough to ignite machine furnaces.

faq.q: What comes next after reaching Rejold Barleybrew?
faq.answer: Rejold needs help before he will hand over his liquor. Reaching Brewnall Village brings you to A Favor for Evershine, where you help the brewer before he gives you a cask for Pilot Bellowfiz.

faq.q: Is Evershine truly safe to drink?
faq.answer: Pilot Bellowfiz says Evershine will flatten almost any dwarf who tries it. The strongest mountain folk can drink it, but its extreme flammability also makes it useful in an engine furnace.

angles.text: As a gnome, you may appreciate how Pilot Bellowfiz turns ordinary things, even dwarven brew, into improvised fuel.
As a dwarf, you know the fiery extremes of dwarven brewing, and Rejold Barleybrew's spirit brings them to Dun Morogh's cold peaks.
As an engineer, you can see how volatile spirits give pilots like Bellowfiz another way to keep siege engines running in harsh conditions.
